integrity: All finite inputs, exact integer filters, relabelling equivalence classes, and balanced partitions are checked by a reproducible standalone standard-library Python program with accompanying complete representative catalogues.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification of five-cell, one-edge-type, valency-two regular networks with loops and parallel arrows permitted; robust coordinate-equality synchrony only; no assertion of nonlinear normal form or existence of a particular bifurcation. title: The five-cell onset and complete synchrony-profile census for two-input zero-Hopf networks
